scope: Working-tree patch review/apply Core foundation for upstream StartExtPatch workflow. Native merge review and full port/distribution remain incomplete.

verification.core: Four cases on four engines = 16 passing executions. Real text/binary/rename/mode/add/delete patch checked and applied, then reversed; original bytes preserved. HEAD and raw index bytes unchanged. Stale current file makes check fail; no other patch files applied, unrelated local modification preserved after valid apply. Unsafe ../ and .git paths rejected; mismatched repository blocked. Empty/malformed/negative-strip input rejected and plain -p0 patch applies.
verification.native: No UI production changes or native receiver run. Native Review Patch command/window remain pending.
verification.builds: Unsigned Debug and Store builds pass. Sources/tests frozen during compiler sessions; Core tests sequential across engines and terminal before builds. Debug then Store sequential.
verification.bundles: Debug/Store validators and NOTICE comparisons, inventory pin, CSV 3277 records/7 fields, documentation site and whitespace checks pass.

iterations: First Apple Core run passes; subsequent three engine runs pass. No repair iteration.

cleanup.fixtures: All four-engine XCTest fixture roots removed via defer. Private patch snapshots removed via defer after review/application, including failed checks. No GUI, private preferences or shared pasteboards used.

limitations: This uses Git CLI whole-patch application as the native backend; full TortoiseGitMerge patch parsing, per-file before/after merge, editing, partial application and patch-path guessing are not implemented.
No visible Review Patch command added until the native workflow exists.
Linked worktrees, signed sandbox external patch/repository access, cancellation and huge/complex patch performance not separately tested.
A fresh --check is followed by normal git apply validation; external writers are not globally locked. Git default failure semantics apply, without --reject or --unsafe-paths.
Statistics/summary are Git text; original document bytes stay immutable. Repository-root binding does not pin HEAD/index, since working-tree applicability is rechecked.
Unsigned builds do not establish signed sandbox/Finder/App Store or screenshot acceptance. GitHub auth/CI/push and CUA remain unavailable from previous evidence, not retried. Full objective active.
